objective: Add an optional local/read-only Graphify code-navigation pilot on PR #106; defer final Continuity testing and all production actions.

decisions: PRs are stacked: #102 Phase A, #104 Phase B, #105 C-G, #106 H-M. None is merged.
Office, Codex and Claude Code have executable adapter code; Codex and Claude require separate explicit flags, supported official CLIs and verified login. Claude is PUBLIC-only until policy review.
Other non-native workers remain MANUAL_ONLY or DISABLED; no unverified integration is presented as executable.
The Supervisor is off by default and requires explicit workspace roots and owner authorization for control actions.
Managed external worktrees fetch the exact remote branch, publish without force, and refuse handoff/recovery when the old writer or branch state is uncertain.
External runtime mirrors live outside writable worktrees; database checkpoints remain authoritative. Provider-issued CLI session IDs are carried in checkpoints for same-worker resume.
New schema uses coding_checkpoints and coding_handoffs; the older POC continuity_* tables are untouched.
Official graphifyy[sql]==0.9.73 is development-only in an ignored virtual environment. Graphify output is ignored, source-only and never a production dependency.
Coding Agent graph hints require CODING_GRAPHIFY_ENABLED=true and a prebuilt local graph; absent or failed Graphify falls back to ordinary source exploration.
